scientific_question: At the same 1280-channel budget as v190-v192, can a deterministic signed global sketch of every omitted detector-potential DCT coordinate preserve the diffuse normal-equation information that sparse coordinate selection loses?
role: post-open development capacity diagnostic on the same four opened PoolFire frames; it tests one fixed result-blind signed aggregation and one unsigned control, not a trained predictor or a deployable cost claim
physical_hypothesis: v192 improved strict cells by selecting large individual normal contributions but still discarded many weak contributions. If the remaining failure is caused by diffuse signed accumulation rather than a few missing peaks, aggregating every non-anchor coordinate into fixed signed buckets should preserve that global contribution at the same compact channel count.
physical_distinction: v193 does not change the v192 score, budget, threshold or selected-coordinate roster. It replaces all 271 adaptive point samples with 271 deterministic linear aggregates over every non-anchor coordinate, so no omitted coordinate is discarded from the compact observation.

already_seen: v189 full camera-resolved DCT K1 is strict-safe in 52/52 five-camera and 52/52 all-nine cells
v190 fixed geometry-only QDEIM1280 K1 is strict-safe in 35/52 five-camera and 30/52 all-nine cells
v191.1 attributes v190 failure to observation-activated normal-metric distortion
v192 normal-contribution adaptive QDEIM improves to 40/52 strict-safe cells in both sensor arms but still fails 12 cells per arm
not_read_or_computed_before_this_freeze: any v193 bucket assignment, sign, compact response, coordinate, field, physical replay or metric
any v193 unsigned-control or signed-primary pass count
pre_result_disclosure.claim_boundary: The same four frames are already-open development data. A pass can establish only fixed-sketch mechanism headroom on this roster; it cannot establish complete-trajectory accuracy, resource savings, external generalization or real BOST.

data_isolation.development_roster: the same p=22kw_size=01 frames 0,25,75,100, 13 frozen calibrations, five-camera and all-nine arms used by v189-v192
data_isolation.prediction_inputs: sealed v189 full camera-resolved detector-potential DCT observations, a response rebuilt only from the frozen affine basis and reported geometry, frozen v190 anchors, reported camera IDs and canonical non-DC mode identities
forbidden_inputs: CFD truth, field metrics or any prior pass mask inside hashing, signs, aggregation, normalization, solve or fallback
frame index, trajectory identity, time, power or size as a sketch feature
PoolFire validation, stopping-validation or test trajectories
real BOST, external data, post-result seeds, bucket counts, normalization, alternate hashes, candidate search or learned predictors
data_isolation.truth_use: only after all bucket maps, compact responses, compact observations, coordinates and initial fields are sealed, to synthesize the already-open vector observations for unchanged physical K1 replay and frozen metrics

fixed_representation.canonical_feature_space: all 575 non-DC 24x24 detector-potential DCT modes per active camera, concatenated after sorting reported camera IDs
fixed_representation.anchors: the exact geometry-only QDEIM anchors sealed by v190; they remain 1009 identity channels and are rebuilt before heldout features are consumed
fixed_representation.non_anchor_domain: every canonical feature coordinate not in the frozen anchor set; no non-anchor coordinate is discarded
fixed_representation.feature_key: key=((reported_camera_id+1)<<32)|(non_dc_mode_index+1), with camera IDs interpreted as nonnegative integers and mode indices 0..574
fixed_representation.hash: SplitMix64 with unsigned modulo-2^64 arithmetic: z=key+0x9E3779B97F4A7C15; z=(z^(z>>30))*0xBF58476D1CE4E5B9; z=(z^(z>>27))*0x94D049BB133111EB; z=z^(z>>31)
fixed_representation.primary_sign: +1 when hash bit 63 is zero and -1 when hash bit 63 is one
fixed_representation.cheap_control_sign: +1 for every non-anchor coordinate with the same frozen bucket map
fixed_representation.aggregation: for each bucket b, sum sign_j*H[:,j] and sign_j*h[j] over all non-anchor j assigned to b; concatenate the 1009 unscaled anchor channels followed by 271 unscaled bucket channels
fixed_representation.normalization: none; standard CountSketch signs are unscaled so the sketched normal matrix is an unbiased estimator of the omitted-coordinate normal matrix
fixed_representation.final_coordinate: solve c H_compact = h_compact by float64 Moore-Penrose SVD with relative singular floor sqrt(float64 epsilon), require retained rank 1009, and use no ridge, reweighting, line search, fallback or candidate choice
fixed_representation.camera_permutation_contract: permuting input camera or ray order must leave canonical camera IDs, feature keys, bucket identities, signs, compact response, coordinates and fields unchanged within frozen tolerances
fixed_representation.variable_cardinality_contract: the same hash, bucket count and solver natively process both five and nine active cameras

evaluation.physical_replay: construct the affine field from the compact coordinate, then apply the exact unchanged v189-v192 one-step CGLS refinement

cost_boundary.dense_online_work_disclosed: both arms read every deployment-visible per-camera DCT observation coordinate once and perform deterministic signed or unsigned accumulation into 271 buckets
cost_boundary.geometry_cache_disclosed: all full response matrices and anchors are geometry-derived setup artifacts; response construction and dense response aggregation remain whole-pipeline setup work
cost_boundary.forbidden_claim: A fixed 1280-channel solve and zero additional exact calls do not establish lower wall time, lower memory or lower complete-pipeline work.

required_validity_gates: all v189-v192 parent hashes and tree seals remain unchanged
the response and v190 anchor reconstruction match the sealed parents within 1e-8 and exactly for anchor indices
every non-anchor coordinate is assigned exactly once to a bucket and no anchor coordinate is aggregated
the primary and control use exactly the frozen bucket map, signs and 1280 compact channels
every compact response retains rank 1009 and every solve has stationarity at most 1e-7
the sketch API exposes no truth, trajectory, frame, time, power or size argument
mutating heldout truth after fixing observation features changes no bucket, compact coordinate or initial field
camera/ray permutation preserves canonical features, keys, buckets, signs, compact responses, coordinates and fields
all four arms physically replay their exact declared calls with no CGLS breakdown
all candidate fields, metrics, maps, compact audits and summaries are finite and have frozen shapes
formal source and all bound inputs remain unchanged
the independent implementation rebuilds hashes, buckets, compact systems, solves, physical replay and metrics without importing the formal v193 module or runner
fixed_decision_order: Any binding, isolation, rank, stationarity, coverage, hashing, noninterference, permutation, replay, call, finite, shape, source or independent-comparison failure makes v193 inconclusive.

If signed_countsketch1280_k1 fails any of the 104 strict cells, conclude FAIL_SIGNED_COUNTSKETCH_CAPACITY_V193 and close this exact hash, sign, bucket-count and anchor-plus-sketch mechanism; do not search seeds, normalization, bucket counts or hybrid scores after seeing the result.

If the signed primary passes all 104 strict cells and unsigned_bucket_sum1280_k1 also passes all 104, conclude PASS_UNSIGNED_BUCKET_SUM_HEADROOM_V193; any follow-up must prefer and separately test the unsigned control.
If the signed primary passes all 104 strict cells and the unsigned control does not, conclude PASS_SIGNED_COUNTSKETCH_HEADROOM_V193.

A passing capacity result authorizes only one separately frozen complete-trajectory development gate for the winning deterministic mechanism. It does not authorize predictor training or resource claims.
